Market today: Fed day volatility is the story, with stocks and bonds swinging wildly. This kind of chop is brutal for leveraged tech/chip names like yours, especially on margin.

Your holdings: QQQ (-7.41%), SMH (-20.77%), SOXL (-63.85%), and QQQI (-9.59%) are all marked SELL. SOXL is particularly concerning given its leveraged nature and deep loss.

Watch: Microsoft (MSFT) is showing a technical setup despite its recent earnings beat, and Qualcomm (QCOM) is facing headwinds.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for any signs of further downside in the chip sector.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming to reduce leverage risk given the deep drawdown and sector weakness.
SMH: Respect the stop at 540; a break below could signal further downside.
No new buys today - hold and watch
